title: Toppen Av Soppen
description: oppen av Soppen is a small Minecraft mod that adds a handful of magical staffs, a powerful Super Carrot, and some other things😉
body:
Yo its a mod, its got a buttplug that does nothing except look good and give a bit of armor, some staffs that do cool stuff like shoot lasers or summon lighting, some are currently missing a few textures, and no way to obtain in survival yet, WIP project gonna get better soon
